card.name: Decimal point after a leading zero
card.fires_on: The period right after a leading 0 in a decimal number, mostly in diluent strengths such as 0.9% sodium chloride or 0.5% lidocaine. Also fires once inside the drug name halobetasol.

modes.label: Decimal point after 0
modes.description: The period between 0 and the digits of a concentration or volume, often before a % sign or mL.
